note: Human overrides that win over the automatic department import. Edit THIS file — never academics/data/units.json (regenerated by the feed) and never the built HTML. Keyed by unit route; each field listed replaces the imported value and survives the next `python3 tools/rebuild_site.py --feed`, because apply_unit_overrides.py re-applies it after the import. Overridable fields: title, summary, official_url, hidden, kind, faculty, eyebrow. Identity and routing (id, route, child links) come from the feed and are not overridable here. Every field you override is stamped in that unit's `overridden` list in units.json, so it is auditable.
